entries.title: John 14:1
segments: ¶"Let not your heart be troubled; you believe in God, believe also in Me.

entries.title: John 14:2
segments: "In My Father's house are many mansions; if [it were] not [so], I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

entries.title: John 14:3
segments: "And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and receive you to Myself; that where I am, [there] you may be also.

entries.title: John 14:4
segments: ¶"And where I go you know, and the way you know."

entries.title: John 14:5
segments: Thomas said to Him, "Lord, we do not know where You are going, and how can we know the way?"

entries.title: John 14:6
segments: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

entries.title: John 14:7
segments: "If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also; and from now on you know Him and have seen Him."

entries.title: John 14:8
segments: Philip said to Him, "Lord, show us the Father, and it is sufficient for us."

entries.title: John 14:9
segments: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you so long, and yet you have not known Me, Philip? He who has seen Me has seen the Father; so how can you say, 'Show us the Father'?

entries.title: John 14:10
segments: "Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in Me? The words that I speak to you I do not speak on My own [authority]; but the Father who dwells in Me does the works.

entries.title: John 14:11
segments: "Believe Me that I [am] in the Father and the Father in Me, or else believe Me for the sake of the works themselves.

entries.title: John 14:12
segments: ¶"Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me, the works that I do he will do also; and greater [works] than these he will do, because I go to My Father.

entries.title: John 14:13
segments: "And whatever you ask in My name, that I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

entries.title: John 14:14
segments: "If you ask anything in My name, I will do [it].

entries.title: John 14:15
segments: ¶"If you love Me, keep My commandments.

entries.title: John 14:16
segments: "And I will pray the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever--

entries.title: John 14:17
segments: "the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him; but you know Him, for He dwells with you and will be in you.

entries.title: John 14:18
segments: ¶"I will not leave you orphans; I will come to you.

entries.title: John 14:19
segments: "A little while longer and the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you will live also.

entries.title: John 14:20
segments: "At that day you will know that I [am] in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.

entries.title: John 14:21
segments: "He who has My commandments and keeps them, it is he who loves Me. And he who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him."

entries.title: John 14:22
segments: Judas (not Iscariot) said to Him, "Lord, how is it that You will manifest Yourself to us, and not to the world?"

entries.title: John 14:23
segments: Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

entries.title: John 14:24
segments: "He who does not love Me does not keep My words; and the word which you hear is not Mine but the Father's who sent Me.

entries.title: John 14:25
segments: ¶"These things I have spoken to you while being present with you.

entries.title: John 14:26
segments: "But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all things that I said to you.

entries.title: John 14:27
segments: "Peace I leave with you, My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

entries.title: John 14:28
segments: ¶"You have heard Me say to you, 'I am going away and coming [back] to you.' If you loved Me, you would rejoice because I said, 'I am going to the Father,' for My Father is greater than I.

entries.title: John 14:29
segments: "And now I have told you before it comes, that when it does come to pass, you may believe.

entries.title: John 14:30
segments: "I will no longer talk much with you, for the ruler of this world is coming, and he has nothing in Me.

entries.title: John 14:31
segments: "But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave Me commandment, so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
